image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a dark, textured rock surface. The salamander has a glossy black body with vivid, irregular yellow spots and bands. Its head is broad with visible parotoid glands, and its skin appears moist and reflective. The limbs are short and stout, and the tail extends behind it, showing the characteristic coloration pattern.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the tail shows lateral compression and the correct coloration pattern. It appears proportionate to the body length.
